teamUrls.title: Team URLs
teamUrls.description: Flashscore team pages, any team sport and any Flashscore edition (.com, .co.uk ...), e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/team/arsenal/hA1Zm19f/. Sub-pages such as .../squad/ work too.
teamUrls.sectionDescription: Any mix of team URLs, player URLs and plain names. Names are looked up with Flashscore's own search; the best team or player match is scraped.

playerUrls.title: Player URLs
playerUrls.description: Flashscore player or coach pages, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/player/saka-bukayo/08NLEo06/.

searchQueries.title: Search by name
searchQueries.description: Team or player names, e.g. "Real Madrid" or "Bukayo Saka". Each name scrapes Flashscore's best team or team-sport player match.

searchSport.title: Search sport
searchSport.description: Only match names in this sport ("Rapperswil" is both a football club and a hockey club).

teamSections.title: Team data
teamSections.description: Profile: venue, capacity, coach, squad size. Squad: every player and coach with season stats and injuries. Results: past matches (newest first). Fixtures: every scheduled match. Transfers: arrivals and departures with fees (newest first).

maxResultsPerTeam.title: Results per team
maxResultsPerTeam.description: Newest results to return per team. 0 = the team's entire history (Arsenal: 5,077 matches, a century of them).

maxTransfersPerTeam.title: Transfers per team
maxTransfersPerTeam.description: Newest transfers to return per team. 0 = every transfer Flashscore lists (Arsenal: about 1,700, back to the 1970s).

squadPerCompetition.title: Squad stats per competition
squadPerCompetition.description: Besides the all-competitions squad table, add one squad table per competition (league, cups, Europe).

scrapeSquadPlayers.title: Full profiles for every squad member
scrapeSquadPlayers.description: Also scrape the player page of everyone in each team's squad (about 30 extra player profiles per team).

playerSections.title: Player data
playerSections.description: Profile: club, position, age, date of birth, market value, contract expiry, height, current injury. Career: one row per season, club and competition. Last matches: the 10 most recent matches with rating and stats. Transfers: career moves with fees. Injuries: injury history.

maxItems.title: Max rows
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows in total.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed: Flashscore does not block by IP. The Actor escalates to Apify proxies automatically if it is ever refused.
